name: Sarkhee's Jewellery
desc1: This small room is lavishly decorated with exquisitely exotic wall
desc2: hangings. A long glass case filled with glittering jewellery stands
desc3: against the west wall, and sitting in a nearby desk is a nice-looking
desc4: goblin. At your entry, he rises and grins toothily. He wears elaborate
desc5: red robes, and his every movement rings with the sound of jangling
desc6: bracelets. You can exit the shop to the east.
